scene.title: SCENE III. The French camp near Dover

lines.text: Why the King of France is so suddenly gone back, know you no reason?
lines.plainText: Why the King of France is so suddenly gone back know you no reason

lines.text: Something he left imperfect in the state, which since his coming forth is thought of, which imports to the kingdom so much fear and danger that his personal return was most required and necessary.
